backfill.name: Backfill statistics
backfill.description: Recomputes the price of missing hours from the day-ahead data published later and writes it into the long-term statistics. It only fills statistics, not the raw state history.

start.name: Start day
start.description: First day to backfill. Defaults to yesterday.

end.name: End day
end.description: Last day to backfill. Defaults to today.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Also overwrite hours that already have statistics. By default only missing hours are filled.
